notes.detailedSummary: For every smooth integral projective surface over any algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, the entire genuine one-net cone of every pseudoeffective actual rational L is identified at every analytic point with its canonical negative-part potential plus the nef positive-part cone. The polytope construction, negative definiteness, inverse-sign minimality, actual section division, and perturbation limit are reconstructed. A finite-rank argument extends the result to pseudoeffective bundles without sections. Nef closure and compactness are independently reconstructed from actual ample G0 using finite continuous regularizers. Division of original FS stages, actual ample maxima, and compact varying-nef subnets establish genuine membership without subtracting shared poles. Full positive-volume energy, operator, envelope, differentiation, comparison, and attainment remain unproved.
notes.text:
Retained hypotheses. Let k be any algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero field, X a smooth integral projective surface, L any actual pseudoeffective rational line bundle, and H an actual ample integral bundle. There is no countability, support, toric, semiampleness, or finite-generation restriction. Every function is on the original X^an. FS stages are actual section maxima m^{-1}max_j(log||s_j||_triv+lambda_j), with real weights and arbitrary base ideals. Genuine PSH(theta) means ONE decreasing directed net of such stages whose numerical classes tend to theta and whose generic-trivial limit is finite. The sole analytic premise is exact actual-ample G0: finite continuous same-bundle regularization, decreasing closure, normalized divisorial compactness, finite evaluations, all-point determination, finite maxima, and actual ample model intersections. Ordinary algebraic positivity, finite-dimensional numerical space, surface intersections, Serre vanishing/duality, and Riemann–Roch are explicit background.

The proved statement is PSH(c1(L))={sigma_N+v:v in PSH(c1(P))}, where L=P+N is its canonical rational surface decomposition. Translation is a homeomorphism of the entire normalized cones. They are compact; arbitrary decreasing nets with finite generic limit have genuine all-point limits with ONE defining FS net. Rational varying-class decreasing closure also holds at every rational pseudoeffective surface endpoint. The intrinsic minimal reference is V_L=sigma_N and vol(L)=P^2. This is a structural and algebraic mass result, not the entire positive-volume equation.

Actual section operations. A generated ample power with weights zero has potential zero everywhere: at each valuation-ring center a generator is a unit of norm one and all generators have norm at most one. Clearing degrees by all tensor products realizes sums exactly, including poles, and multiplies actual base ideals. If c1(T)-theta is ample, then eventually T-B_i is actual ample for an original defining net. Tensoring its zero systems puts the unchanged stages on the same actual T, even if T itself is nonample. A sufficiently large actual ample T therefore determines already genuine functions by divisorial coordinates. This does not establish membership of a new limit.

Nef foundation. For every actual nef rational P, PSH(P)=intersection over rational epsilon>0 of PSH(P+epsilon H). Forward inclusion is the section embedding. Conversely choose finite continuous G0 regularizers f_{epsilon,j} decreasing to the same function u. Order triples (epsilon,j,b), b>0, by decrease of epsilon, b, and f_{epsilon,j}+b. Given two triples, choose smaller epsilon_3 and b_3<min(b_1,b_2). The finite continuous R=min(f_1+b_1,f_2+b_2) strictly exceeds u+b_3 everywhere, even where u=-infinity. The open negative sets of exp(f_{epsilon_3,j}+b_3)-exp(R) increase and cover the compact carrier, so one late j works everywhere. This makes the preorder directed. Finite thresholds prove its all-point limit is u, including poles, and epsilon tends to zero. This is ONE actual defining net. Each decreasing nef net lies in every fixed ample perturbation, so ample closure followed by this intersection construction proves nef closure. For normalized compactness, the compact ample cones K_{P+epsilon H}, 0<epsilon<=1, have closed images in Hausdorff K_{P+H}. Their intersection has the same actual representatives by ample determination and is exactly the normalized nef cone. For varying nef P_a tending to P, normalized functions embed eventually in one compact ample K_A. Every subnet limit lies in each closed K_{P+delta H}, since P+delta H-P_a is eventually ample, and therefore is genuinely P-psh.

Finite algebraic decomposition. For effective D=sum d_i C_i, maximize sum p_i on the rational polytope 0<=p_i<=d_i and sum_i p_i(C_i.C_j)>=0 for each j. These are exactly the effective nef subdivisors. Coordinatewise maxima are feasible: in the jth constraint keep the larger diagonal coordinate and increase only coordinates with nonnegative off-diagonal coefficients. Hence the rational maximizing vertex is the unique greatest feasible vector. Put P=sum p_iC_i and N=D-P. If C_j occurs in N, then P.C_j=0, since otherwise increasing p_j slightly stays feasible. Its negative-support matrix Q is negative definite. Otherwise a Rayleigh-quotient maximizer can be replaced by its absolute values to give a nonnegative eigenvector q with Qq>=0. Its effective real divisor is nef, since intersections with every other curve are nonnegative. Adding a small multiple to P stays in the polytope and improves the maximum, a contradiction.

For such Q, Q^{-1}<=0 entrywise. Put A=-Q. If Ax=b>=0 and x=x_+-x_- with disjoint nonnegative parts and x_- nonzero, then 0<=b.x_-=x_+^T A x_- -x_-^T A x_-<0. Thus A^{-1}>=0. If numerically L=q_0+M with q_0 nef and M effective, write N=sum a_iC_i and M=sum m_iC_i+M' outside the negative support. Orthogonality gives Q(a-m)_i-M'.C_i>=0, hence Q(a-m)>=0 and a-m<=0. Therefore M>=N. This proves numerical uniqueness of the actual negative divisor. The positive part is the ACTUAL bundle P=L-N.

For a section of actual integral mL, its zero divisor T=sum t_iC_i+T' satisfies Q(t-ma)_i=-T'.C_i<=0. The inverse sign yields t>=ma. Thus every section divides by the actual canonical section of ceil(mN); for degrees clearing N, multiplication by s_{mN} gives exactly H^0(mP) isomorphic to H^0(mL). No section-ring finite generation is used.

Pseudoeffective extension. Actual L+epsilon H is big for every rational epsilon>0: approximate c1(L) by effective rational D_j, so L+epsilon H-D_j is actual ample on a tail, and multiply its ample sections by the D_j section. Construct N_epsilon as above. Minimality gives N_epsilon<=N_epsilon' when epsilon'<epsilon. Each negative support has at most rho=dim N^1(X)_R curves, because a numerical relation gives a kernel vector of its negative definite matrix. Their nested union also has at most rho curves: any rho+1 curves would occur together at one sufficiently small epsilon. Thus the union is finite and occurs entirely in some N_{epsilon_0}. Its coefficients are bounded by N_epsilon.H <= (L+epsilon H).H <= L.H+H^2 for epsilon<=1. They increase to a finite N. Closed nefness gives P=L-N nef, and stable-support orthogonality gives P.C_i=0. The same invertible rational matrix satisfies Q a=(L.C_i), so a is rational. This constructs the canonical decomposition even when L has no sections, with N_epsilon increasing to N and P_epsilon tending numerically to P.

Entire all-point identification. Define sigma_N=q^{-1}log|s_{qN}|. It is finite at divisorial valuations and has generic value zero. For v nef-psh, its ONE finite continuous nef regularizing net p_a on P+delta_a H gives actual stages sigma_N+p_a on L+delta_a H. Their base ideal is exactly the canonical negative-part ideal with its full normalized order, because p_a generates. At a reference pole every stage already equals minus infinity. This proves membership from the translated nef cone.

Conversely take normalized genuine u with original stages f_i. For each epsilon>0, put the unchanged stages on actual L+epsilon H by zero-system tensoring. Clear N_epsilon's denominator by all section products, then divide every section by s_{mN_epsilon}. The actual residual systems g_i on P_epsilon obey f_i=sigma_{N_epsilon}+g_i as a product identity everywhere, not subtraction at shared poles. They decrease divisorially. Put them in a fixed actual ample cone. The actual FS maximum of two comparable stages agrees divisorially with the earlier stage, so ample determination promotes the order everywhere. Nef closure gives actual normalized v_epsilon with coordinates u-sigma_{N_epsilon}. Its sum with sigma_{N_epsilon} is already genuine; a common ample embedding identifies it with u at ALL points. Compact varying-nef subnets yield actual v in PSH(P) with finite divisorial coordinates u-sigma_N. The already constructed sigma_N+v and already genuine u then agree everywhere by common ample determination. No subtraction at shared poles or interchange of two all-point limits occurs.

Translation by finite sigma_N coordinates is a homeomorphism, so nef compactness gives whole surface compactness. For decreasing u_i=sigma_N+v_i, divisorial order of the remainders is promoted to all-point order using genuine ample maxima. Nef closure gives v=inf v_i; literal addition gives inf u_i=sigma_N+v, including reference poles, with the constructed ONE net sigma_N+p_a. Also PSH(L)=intersection_epsilon PSH(L+epsilon H), by the same varying-nef compact-limit argument. If theta_i tends to c1(L) and u_i decreases, each fixed L+epsilon H contains an eventual tail through an ample class difference. Its proved surface closure and this intersection give varying-class closure.

Reference and volume. Every u<=0 has remainder v<=0, since sup v=v(x_0)=u(x_0)<=0. Conversely sigma_N is genuine with remainder zero. Therefore the attained intrinsic envelope is V_L=sigma_N, and max(u,V_L-j)=sigma_N+max(v,-j), including shared poles. For a fixed actual twist B, inject its sections into mP+tH, then into mP+(t+ceil(m delta))H. Separating finitely many residue degrees gives growing powers of ample P+delta H plus fixed twists. Serre vanishing and Riemann–Roch yield limsup 2h^0(mP+B)/m^2 <= (P+delta H)^2, hence <=P^2. If P^2>0, nefness and openness imply P.H>0; otherwise P.(H-aP)<0 for a small ample H-aP. Then H^0(K-mP)=0 for large divisible m, and duality/Riemann–Roch give h^0(mP)>=m^2P^2/2+O(m). If P^2=0 the upper bound suffices. For every degree clearing L, divide by ceil(mN). Writing m=aq+r with q clearing L,N,P leaves aqP+B_r with finitely many actual twists. The same upper bound covers every residue, while divisible section equality supplies the lower bound. Thus vol(L)=P^2. On F_2, L=2S+3F has N=S/2, P=3S/2+3F, L^2=4 and vol(L)=9/2, showing why raw mass need not be L^2.

notes.detailedSummary: Integer scaling and compact ample divisorial bounds force normalized numerical-zero psh functions to vanish everywhere. Their actual product-model operator and energy are zero. notes.text:
This proves zero-volume equations in two precise ranges, not original P16.5.

Let k and smooth integral projective X satisfy n1's retained hypotheses, in any positive dimension, and let B be an ACTUAL numerically trivial rational bundle, including nontorsion Pic^0 bundles. Constants are genuine by the reconstructed nef intersection formula. For normalized u in PSH(0), integer tensor powers of its defining net prove mu genuine in class zero for every positive integer m. Embed these unchanged normalized functions into one actual ample H cone. At each divisorial z, finite evaluation on its compact normalized cone has a finite lower bound -C_z. Thus -C_z<=m u(z)<=0 for every m, so u(z)=0. Both u and zero are already genuine in the same ample cone; all-point determination gives u=0 everywhere. Therefore the ENTIRE cone is R, without countability.

A nonzero section of an integral multiple of B is nowhere vanishing: a nonzero effective zero divisor would have positive H^{n-1} degree but numerical class zero. Such a section trivializes that multiple, so every section space has dimension at most one and volume is zero. The canonical actual product-model metric has genuine raw top product (B^n)delta_{x_0}=0. Constants change no product. Its raw model energy normalized at zero is E(c)=c(B^n)=0. Since all genuine functions are constants, the entire finite-energy space is exactly R, with no additional endpoints to construct. A positive Radon measure of mass zero is necessarily zero, of intrinsic dual energy sup_c[E(c)-integral c d0]=0. Every constant solves its equation; any two differ by a constant. The normalized cone is one actual compact point, comparison integrals vanish, and a continuous obstacle f has envelope min f and outer energy zero. Both directional derivatives are zero. No division by volume occurs.

Now take a retained surface L=P+N with c1(P)=0. By n1 and the preceding proof, its entire genuine cone is sigma_N+R. This includes nonzero classes such as an exceptional divisor. Its intrinsic reference is V_L=sigma_N, and every genuine function retains this type exactly.

The relative product is constructed directly. On U=X minus Supp(N), remove the ACTUAL nonvanishing canonical N section in the frame of L=P+N. The metric with potential sigma_N+c is exactly the canonical metric of actual P shifted by c. Its local product-model top curvature measure is zero. Extend this actual local intersection product to ORIGINAL X^an with zero mass on the reference pole set Supp(N)^an. The resulting zero nonpluripolar measure is independent of a target or lift. It also agrees with the limit of constant actual ample products for P+epsilon H, whose masses are epsilon^2 H^2. The generally negative signed number N^2 is not used as this positive product.

The relative energy difference of translated reference metrics is their constant difference integrated against the usual sum of these local top products, extended with zero polar mass. Every term is zero. Normalize E_L(sigma_N)=0, giving E_L(sigma_N+c)=0. These are ALL genuine functions, so the entire actual relative finite-energy space is sigma_N+R. Relative floors stay in this cone. Raw mass is vol(L)=P^2=0, and the sole positive target is zero, of relative dual energy zero. Integrals are taken on U, with no subtraction of infinities at reference poles. All translated references are actual solutions and differ by constants. The normalized solution is literally the reference, so attainment is explicit. For continuous f, the cone envelope of sigma_N+c+tf is sigma_N+c+inf_{U^an}(tf); its outer relative energy and both derivatives are zero.

Unnormalized domination fails even for constants c<d, since a zero measure distinguishes no set. Uniqueness in these ranges comes from rigidity of the entire cone modulo constants. No theorem on other nonzero zero-volume classes follows. Complete proofs are Sections 8.1–8.2 of P16.5-argument.md and P16.5-paper.tex. notes.summary: Higher-dimensional fixed-ideal gate: for a smooth center of codimension c, J(I^t)=I^{max(0,floor(t)-c+1)}. Hence J(I^{m(1+epsilon)}) is contained in I^m exactly when m epsilon>=c-1. Actual weighted monomial systems for a linear ideal on P^n give all-point order, exact vanishing slopes and class cost <=epsilon+1/m. This does not regularize arbitrary genuine potentials.
notes.detailedSummary: The formula is proved using the explicit smooth-center blowup, discrepancy (c-1)E, and exact exceptional-power pushforwards, without Nadel vanishing. For a linear ideal, displayed monomials generate I^r(r); a generated residual zero system gives degree-q sections with exact base ideal I^r and summed real weights. Their potential is (r/m)f, at most normalized f everywhere when r>=m, with vanishing class error in the fixed-model example. Intrinsic weighted ideals, uniform generation and convergence for arbitrary directed psh nets remain unproved.
notes.text:
Let Y be smooth in characteristic zero, Z a nonempty smooth center of constant codimension c>=1, and I its ideal. Using the multiplier-ideal definition pi_*O(K_relative-floor(tF)), the formula J(I^t)=I^r, r=max(0,floor(t)-c+1), holds for real t>=0.

Proof: for c>=2, blow up Z. In coordinates x_1,...,x_c normal to the center, the x_1 chart has coordinates x_1,x_2/x_1,...,x_c/x_1. Its Jacobian factor is x_1^{c-1}; hence K_relative=(c-1)E and I O=O(-E). This one-divisor log resolution gives J(I^t)=pi_*O((c-1-floor(t))E). A nonnegative exceptional coefficient pushes forward to O_Y, because a rational function with possible poles only over codimension at least two has no height-one pole on the smooth normal base. A coefficient -r<0 pushes forward to I^r: the associated graded of the regular-sequence ideal is the polynomial algebra on I/I^2, and its first nonzero homogeneous term gives exactly the exceptional order. Order at least r is membership in I^r. For c=1, the identity resolution gives I^{floor(t)}.

For integer m>=1 and t=m(1+epsilon), r>=m exactly when floor(m epsilon)>=c-1, equivalently m epsilon>=c-1. Powers of a nonempty smooth-center ideal strictly decrease locally, so this is exactly the threshold for containment in I^m. A factor 1+epsilon can absorb the codimension loss while epsilon tends to zero. This preserves full order, not merely a pole set.

Actual global generation and class estimates are proved in the SPECIFIED model Y=P^n, 1<=c<=n, I=(Z_0,...,Z_{c-1}). Choose arbitrary real weights lambda_i with max lambda_i=0 and f=max_{i<c}(log||Z_i||_triv+lambda_i) on actual O(1). Set r=floor(m(1+epsilon))-c+1 and q=ceil(m(1+epsilon)), assuming m epsilon>=c-1. All degree-r monomials in these c coordinates generate I^r(r); give them the actual summed lambda weights. Tensor with all degree-(q-r) coordinate monomials of O(q-r), whose zero-weight potential is zero by n1's section operation. This concrete global degree-q system has exact local base ideal I^r and potential psi=(r/m)f on the ACTUAL rational bundle O(q/m). Since f<=0 and r/m>=1, psi<=f at every point, including shared poles. Its recession along every scaled divisorial valuation is r/m times the original minimum generator order. The class cost q/m-1 is at most epsilon+1/m. Choosing epsilon=(c-1)/m gives r=m, q=m+c-1, and the SAME function f with classes tending to O(1). No vanishing theorem or unspecified model is used.

All displayed real weights are handled exactly through actual monomial weights. This does not identify the unweighted J(I^t) with a weighted multiplier ideal of an arbitrary potential u. It supplies no intrinsic nonzero coherent regularizer for arbitrary directed nets, no uniform generation on general X in class (1+epsilon)L+o(1), and no convergence or directed simultaneous comparison theorem. Individual Serre generation does not bound its twist uniformly; Nadel positivity on an unconstructed nef model is not assumed.

For contrast, on P^1 set tau=log|s| and f_j=max(tau,-j). At a ord_{s=0}, a>=j, the correction f_j+delta tau+C has value -j-delta a+C. For 0<delta<1 it is <=tau=-a only when (1-delta)a<=j-C, which fails for large a. The fixed-model construction above preserves coefficient at least one instead.

Complete proofs are Section 10 of P16.5-argument.md. checks-output.json records 1920 exact rational threshold cases and 600 rational witnesses against small-exponent correction. These are finite observations, not a proof for arbitrary u. Run python3 checks.py or python3 rerun.py.

notes.text:
The unchanged original P16.5 is NOT solved. Status is PARTIAL and candidate=false. The entire surface structural result and narrower zero-volume and ideal results of n1–n3 do not constitute the arbitrary-dimensional nonample finite-energy equation.

Zero-volume obstruction. On X=P^1 x P^1 over a retained field, let A=O(1,0), B=O(0,1), L=A and H=A+B. L is nef, N=0, V_L=0 and vol(L)=L^2=0. If s,t generate O(1) on the first factor, f=max(log|s|,log|t|-1) pulled back to X is a finite continuous actual normalized FS potential. Along a ord_{s=0}, f=-min(a,1), while along the opposite fiber valuation it is zero; thus it is nonconstant. Its curve FS model pulls back to the product with the second P^1. The metric line bundle is pulled from the two-dimensional curve test configuration; on each central surface component it is pulled from a curve, so its square is zero, and its three-fold raw energy intersection is zero. Therefore f and zero have the same genuine raw nef MODEL product zero and finite model energy zero. Alternatively, tensoring zero systems puts both bounded functions in actual ample A+epsilon H. Their positive G0 measures have mass 2epsilon+2epsilon^2, so all continuous-test integrals tend to zero. Any zero-volume theory retaining these model endpoints, energies and raw products has two normalized zero-target solutions. Unrestricted uniqueness modulo constants is impossible in this nonzero class. The rigid ranges in n2 are not contradicted.

Remaining foundational statements. In dimension at least three, for EVERY retained smooth original X and actual big rational L, prove that every arbitrary decreasing genuine psh net with finite generic limit has an all-point limit admitting ONE actual decreasing FS defining net with classes tending to c1(L). Then prove normalized divisorial compactness with genuine representatives without assuming this closure. The defective extended-real flattening lemma and its dependent nonample compactness are not premises. An unspecified nef b-divisor does not supply actual sections, original-carrier membership, descent or order.

The multiplier route still needs intrinsic nonzero coherent weighted ideals or compatible filtrations for arbitrary real-weight directed nets; all-point monotonicity; quantitative full-order containment against each actual FS obstacle; original-X generation with class cost (1+epsilon)c1(L)+o(1) under proved geometric vanishing hypotheses; convergence; and a directed simultaneous lower-stage comparison. None follows from n3's fixed smooth-center/linear-ideal calculation. Individual Serre twists may grow too fast. Matching pole sets or recession slopes does not establish all-point order or a double-limit interchange.

Positive-volume surfaces still require a genuine entire unbounded finite-energy theory for every actual BIG NEF positive part P, with target-independent products of mass P^2, mixed and weighted monotone limits, independence and genuine endpoints. Finite energy in a desired P theory has not been proved equivalent to finite energy in any fixed ample perturbation; G0 cannot simply be applied to P. One must then prove original continuous-obstacle envelope regularity and both-sign energy differentiation, polar-nullness and actual nonpluripolar energy/operator transfer through sigma_N, comparison, all-solution uniqueness, intrinsic target characterization, compact cost sublevels and target-integral continuity. Finally prove variational attainment by an actual genuine function and its original-carrier equation for arbitrary-support mass-compatible finite-energy measures.

After constructing these foundations, a possible intrinsic positive-mass target condition is mu>=0, mass vol(L)>0, no mass on {V_L=-infinity}, and finite supremum over normalized ACTUAL E1 potentials of E_L(u)+integral_{V_L finite}(V_L-u)dmu, with E_L(V_L)=0. This is an outstanding goal, not a proved operator characterization here. At zero volume probability normalization is impossible, and larger theories need revised uniqueness or data.
